description: This file appears to be a C header file defining data structures, function prototypes, and external references related to 'tags' within a version control system. It declares a 'tag' struct, related function prototypes for handling tags, and external variables, serving as an interface for tag-related operations.

classes.name: tag
classes.description: Structure representing a tag, including object data, a tagged object pointer, tag string, and date.

methods.name: lookup_tag
methods.description: Retrieves a tag object from repository given an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tag_buffer
methods.description: Parses raw data buffer into a tag object.

methods.name: parse_tag
methods.description: Parses a tag from repository data.

methods.name: release_tag_memory
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a tag object.

methods.name: deref_tag
methods.description: Dereferences a tag to obtain the object it points to.

methods.name: gpg_verify_tag
methods.description: Verifies the GPG signature of a tag.

methods.name: get_tagged_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID of the tagged object.
